verdict.rationale: Shopify POS is a SaaS commerce product that ships AI features (Sidekick), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair axis to ask about. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any setting, policy, or opt-out that stops merchant data from being used to train AI models. The Sidekick mentions describe AI features only and say nothing about data-use controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
